user.title: Connect to OpenRGB
user.description: Enable the SDK server in OpenRGB. Enter the computer's LAN address, not 0.0.0.0 or Home Assistant's address.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect or read devices. Check the SDK server, address, port and firewall.
